input.prompt:

Please find:
1. The main component file(s) for the game day summary page (search under src/app/footy/** and src/components/**).

3. Where/how a "goalie" or "goalkeeper" indicator is rendered next to the player name (icon, badge, emoji, text suffix, etc.) — look for terms like "goalie", "goalkeeper", "GK", "keeper".

Report back: exact file paths, line numbers, and relevant code excerpts for the player name rendering and goalie indicator rendering. Search breadth: thorough.

<result>I now have a complete, thorough picture of the component chain. Here's the report.

## Summary

Component chain (top-down):

```
src/app/footy/game/[id]/page.tsx
  └─ src/components/GameDaySummary/GameDaySummary.tsx
       └─ src/components/Team/Team.tsx
            └─ src/components/TeamPlayer/TeamPlayer.tsx   ← the "card" component
                 ├─ src/components/PlayerMugshot/PlayerMugshot.tsx
                 ├─ src/components/PlayerLink/PlayerLink.tsx   ← renders name + goalie indicator
                 │    └─ src/components/GoalieIndicator/GoalieIndicator.tsx
                 └─ src/components/PlayerForm/PlayerForm.tsx
```

### 1. Main page/entry component
- `/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/app/footy/game/[id]/page.tsx` — route page (`GamePage`), fetches `gameDay`, `teamA`/`teamB` and renders `<GameDaySummary>` (line 111-117).
- `/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/components/GameDaySummary/GameDaySummary.tsx` — top summary component; lines 58-72 render two `<Team>` components side by side in a `Flex direction={{ base: "column", xs: "row" }}` (mobile stacks teams, wider screens go side-by-side).

### 2. Card component that renders each player's name (the "wider-screen card layout")
`/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/components/TeamPlayer/TeamPlayer.tsx` (full file, 65 lines) — this is the per-player card. Key excerpt:

```tsx
19  export const TeamPlayer = ({ teamPlayer }: Props) => (
25      <Card p={0} padding={0} withBorder orientation="horizontal">
31          <Card.Section w={{ base: "2.0rem", xs: "5.5rem" }}>
34              <PlayerMugshot player={teamPlayer} />
37          </Card.Section>
39          <Card.Section px="md" py={2} flex={1}>
44              <Flex
45                  align="center"
46                  direction={{ base: "row", xs: "column" }}
47                  justify={{ base: "space-between", xs: "center" }}
48                  h="100%"
49              >
50                  <Group align="center" gap="xs">
51                      <PlayerLink
52                          player={teamPlayer}
53                          year={0}
54                          wrap
55                          goalie={teamPlayer.outcome.goalie}
56                      />
57                  </Group>
58                  <PlayerForm form={teamPlayer.form} />
61              </Flex>
62          </Card.Section>
64      </Card>
65  );
```

- The responsive "wide-screen card layout" is the `xs` breakpoint variant of the inner `Flex`: `direction={{ base: "row", xs: "column" }}` and `justify={{ base: "space-between", xs: "center" }}` — on mobile (`base`) it's a row (name left, form right); on wider screens (`xs`+) it stacks into a centered column (name above form).
- The name + goalie indicator are wrapped together in `<Group align="center" gap="xs">` (lines 50-57), containing a single `<PlayerLink>` call with `wrap` and `goalie={teamPlayer.outcome.goalie}` props.

### 3. Where the player's name is actually rendered
`/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/components/PlayerLink/PlayerLink.tsx`:

```tsx
36  export interface Props {
37      player: PlayerType;
38      year: number;
39      format?: 'name' | 'left-arrow' | 'right-arrow';
40      wrap?: boolean;
41      goalie?: boolean | null | undefined;
42  }
44  export const PlayerLink = ({ player, year, format = 'name', wrap = false, goalie = false }: Props) => {
    ...
70      const link = (
71          <Anchor
72              href={`/footy/player/${player.id}${year ? `/${year}` : ''}`}
73              aria-label={ariaLabel}
74              miw={miw}
75          >
76              {(() => {
77                  switch (format) {
78                      case 'name':
79                          return player.name;          // <-- player name text
...
85              })()}
86              {goalie ? <GoalieIndicator /> : null}     // <-- goalie indicator, sibling of the name text, inside the same <Anchor>
87          </Anchor>
88      );
```

- `miw` (min-width) on the `Anchor` comes from `theme.other.playerNameMinWidthMultiLine` (`"9em"`, used when `wrap` is true — this is the case used by `TeamPlayer`) or `playerNameMinWidthSingleLine` (`"18em"`, used elsewhere e.g. `PlayerList`). Defined in `/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/theme.ts` lines 10-13, typed in `/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/types/mantine.d.ts` lines 8-10.
- Note: the name text and the `GoalieIndicator` are both children of the same `<Anchor>` — there's no separate flex/group wrapper between them controlling spacing; alignment of the two is instead handled by `GoalieIndicator`'s own `display="inline-flex"`.

### 4. The goalie indicator component itself
`/Volumes/Development/next-www-toastboy/src/components/GoalieIndicator/GoalieIndicator.tsx` (full file, 36 lines):

```tsx
9   export const GoalieIndicator = () => (
10      <Tooltip label="Goalie" withArrow>
11          <Flex
12              role="img"
13              aria-label="Goalie indicator"
14              display="inline-flex"
15              justify="flex-start"
16              align="center"
17              ms="0.25rem"
18          >
19              <IconHandStop stroke={1.25} color="black" fill="white"
20                  style={{ height: 'auto', transform: 'scaleX(-1)' }} size="1rem" />
26              <IconHandStop stroke={1.25} color="black" fill="white"
30                  style={{ height: 'auto' }} size="1rem" />
33          </Flex>
34      </Tooltip>
35  );
```

- Renders two mirrored `IconHandStop` icons (from `@tabler/icons-react`) side by side (a "goalkeeper gloves" visual), wrapped in a Mantine `Tooltip` with label "Goalie", inside an inline-flex `Flex` with `ms="0.25rem"` (margin-start, i.e. left margin in LTR) to space it from the preceding name text.
- `goalie` boolean prop is sourced from `teamPlayer.outcome.goalie` (see `TeamPlayer.tsx` line 55), which traces back through `src/services/Outcome/Outcome.ts` and `src/types` (`TeamPlayerType`) to the DB `Player`/`Outcome` goalie flag (added in commit `9650f18d SYS-474 Add goalie flag to Player model...`).
